name: com.zenn/logo-maker
title: Zenn logo maker
description: Design logos and a brand kit for any business: give a name and industry, get live logo ideas.

tools.name: make_logos
tools.description: Design logo ideas for a business name with Zenn, the AI logo maker and brand kit builder. Use it when someone wants a logo, logo ideas or a brand for a business, shop, channel or project. Returns live logo designs for the name, a live matching four-page website preview, and links to customise and download the logo and a full brand kit (business cards, social media kit, brand guide, website).

name.description: The business or brand name to put in the logo, exactly as it should be written.

industry.description: What the business does, in a few words, e.g. bakery, plumber, gaming channel, law firm, skincare brand.
